risks: Independent verification and post-integration smoke remain separate gates; implementation evidence is not an independent PASS or integration receipt.
A20/A21 prove the rules module's typed authoritative-state boundary. Actual request normalization, case loading, challenge projection and HTTP routing remain with their owning API batches.

P0 internal evaluation retains suppressed rules. A future API consumer must map ProhibitedActionError to HTTP 400 and persist evaluation.fact_trace in its internal audit; the strict error envelope has data=null.

E2 component/role/coverage-specific explanations require the server-owned EvidenceAggregation argument when those facts are not represented in AccountabilityState. The rule does not invent a changed evidence field.
ResolutionPath and RuntimeMetrics are caller-supplied; no resolution planner or observed-usage collector was implemented in this batch.
